limitations: Applies to the standard Euclidean coordinate realization of partial permutohedra, not arbitrary polymatroids or other affine metrics; equivalent prior results under alternate terminology cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and exact-rational checker given; earlier capped-cube ellipsoid theorem and classical simplex John ellipsoid are credited. Source authorship is not asserted for the new theorem. Independent review has not occurred.
title: All partial permutohedra inherit an exact John ellipsoid from a simplex or a capped cube
